comparison_candidates.known_risk: SmolLM2 family is primarily English; Spanish reasoning quality must be measured.

fallback.role: compatibility fallback while Qwen3 weights/runtime are unavailable

promotion_requirements: fixed reasoning benchmark against the current fallback
peak memory and cold-start latency on browser and Android hardware
artifact bytes measured from the exact downloaded files
no holdout leakage into prompts, training or model selection
training_note: Quantized inference artifacts are not trainable checkpoints. LoRA/QLoRA must use a separately pinned trainable base checkpoint and an independent protected holdout.
